lineage.description: Drone orthomosaic imagery was acquired by GLOBHE using crowddroning methodology in the post-event period following Tropical Storm Chalane in Blantyre, Malawi. The georeferenced orthomosaic provides high-resolution spatial data of buildings and natural environment features for exposure mapping.
